coverageMeaning: Every current registry record is examined and explicitly accounted for. A nomination or absence of one never resolves identity. Candidate pairs remain queued until reviewed; new campaign records require a new pinned run.
limitations: No embeddings, model calls, semantic entailment or automatic canonicalization.
Source reuse may be a comparison, compound target or outside probe; it does not establish equivalence or add geometric mass.
Factor label matches nominate comparisons only; even unflagged factor annotations are not independently certified premises.
All systems, regimes, exclusions and qualifications must be compared by review before equivalence or parent decisions.
High-weight broad vocabulary may still generate false positives; weak/unmatched scopes remain explicit review work.
